text: 有枣无枣三竿子——乱打一通
pinyin: yǒu zǎo wú zǎo sān gān zi —— luàn dǎ yī tōng
literal: have · jujube · no · jujube · three · poles — random · hit · one · bout
natural: With or without dates, three swings of the pole

meaning.en: Trying at random without a clear aim.
meaning.zh: 不管树上有无枣子先打三竿，比喻没有目标地乱来一通。

examples.zh: 别有枣无枣三竿子，先想好方案再动手。
examples.en: Don't hit out at random; plan first.

examples.zh: 有枣无枣三竿子——乱打一通，效果肯定不好。
examples.en: Randomly flailing won't give good results.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 有钱人家的看门狗——势利眼
pinyin: yǒu qián rén jiā de kān mén gǒu —— shì lì yǎn
literal: have · money · household · 's · guard · dog — snobbish · eye
natural: A rich family's guard dog: sizing people up

meaning.en: Snobbish; treats people by their wealth.
meaning.zh: 有钱人家的狗看人衣着狗仗人势，比喻势利、嫌贫爱富。

examples.zh: 他像有钱人家的看门狗，势利眼。
examples.en: He's a snob who treats people by their status.

examples.zh: 有钱人家的看门狗——势利眼，见穷人就冷淡。
examples.en: Cold toward the poor, as snobs are.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 油漆匠的家当——有两把刷子
pinyin: yóu qī jiàng de jiā dàng —— yǒu liǎng bǎ shuā zi
literal: painter · 's · belongings — have · two · brushes
natural: A painter's belongings: two brushes

meaning.en: Genuinely skilled.
meaning.zh: 油漆匠有刷子，谐“有两下子”，比喻有真本事。

examples.zh: 他是油漆匠的家当，有两把刷子。
examples.en: He really knows his stuff.

examples.zh: 油漆匠的家当——有两把刷子，别小看他。
examples.en: Don't underestimate him; he's got real skill.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. It plays on 有两把刷子 meaning 'to have real skill'.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。借“有两把刷子”表示有真本事。

text: 用小虾钓鲤鱼——吃小亏占大便宜
pinyin: yòng xiǎo xiā diào lǐ yú —— chī xiǎo kuī zhàn dà pián yí
literal: use · small · shrimp · fish for · carp — eat · small · loss · gain · big · advantage
natural: Baiting with a small shrimp to catch a carp

meaning.en: Giving up a little to gain a lot.
meaning.zh: 用小虾做饵钓大鱼，比喻舍小利得大利。

equivalents: throw a sprat to catch a mackerel

examples.zh: 他用小虾钓鲤鱼，先送样品再拿大单。
examples.en: He gave away samples first to win a big order.

examples.zh: 用小虾钓鲤鱼——吃小亏占大便宜，这招挺高明。
examples.en: Sacrificing little for a big gain; clever move.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 迎风吐唾沫——自作自受
pinyin: yíng fēng tǔ tuò mò —— zì zuò zì shòu
literal: face · wind · spit · saliva — self · do · self · suffer
natural: Spitting into the wind

meaning.en: Bringing trouble on oneself.
meaning.zh: 迎着风吐唾沫，最后落到自己脸上，比喻害人反害己。

examples.zh: 他造谣中伤别人，迎风吐唾沫，自作自受。
examples.en: His slander has backfired; he's brought it on himself.

examples.zh: 迎风吐唾沫，别怪别人。
examples.en: Don't blame others; it's your own doing.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 婴儿饿肚皮——有奶便是娘
pinyin: yīng ér è dù pí —— yǒu nǎi biàn shì niáng
literal: baby · hungry · belly — have · milk · then · is · mother
natural: A hungry baby: whoever gives milk is Mum

meaning.en: Loyal only to whoever provides benefits.
meaning.zh: 饿了的婴儿谁有奶就认谁为娘，比喻谁给好处就跟谁。

equivalents: loyal only to the one who feeds them

examples.zh: 他是婴儿饿肚皮，有奶便是娘，没有原则。
examples.en: He follows whoever pays; he has no principles.

examples.zh: 婴儿饿肚皮，有奶便是娘，这样的人靠不住。
examples.en: You can't rely on someone loyal only to money.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 一条腿的板凳——站不住脚
pinyin: yī tiáo tuǐ de bǎn dèng —— zhàn bù zhù jiǎo
literal: one · leg · 's · stool — stand · not · steady · foot
natural: A one-legged stool can't stand

meaning.en: An argument or position that cannot be sustained.
meaning.zh: 一条腿的板凳立不稳，比喻理由不充分，站不住脚。

examples.zh: 他的理由一条腿的板凳，站不住脚。
examples.en: His argument doesn't hold water.

examples.zh: 一条腿的板凳——站不住脚，这个说法没人信。
examples.en: That claim doesn't stand up.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 一颗心悬在半天云里——上不着天，下不着地
pinyin: yī kē xīn xuán zài bàn tiān yún lǐ —— shàng bù zháo tiān, xià bù zháo dì
literal: one · piece · heart · hang · in · half · sky · cloud · in — up · not · reach · sky, down · not · reach · ground
natural: A heart hanging in the clouds, touching neither sky nor ground

meaning.en: Left in suspense and unable to settle.
meaning.zh: 心悬在半空，上下都不着边，比喻心里不踏实、进退两难。

examples.zh: 等面试结果，他一颗心悬在半天云里，上不着天，下不着地。
examples.en: Waiting for the interview result, he was in limbo.

examples.zh: 一颗心悬在半天云里，上不着天，下不着地，真难受。
examples.en: Being in suspense is awful.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 一脚踢不出个屁来——窝囊废
pinyin: yī jiǎo tī bù chū gè pì lái —— wō nāng fèi
literal: one · kick · not · out · (measure) · fart · come — spineless · waste
natural: You can't even kick a fart out of him: a spineless wimp

meaning.en: A hopelessly timid, ineffectual person.
meaning.zh: 踢一脚也没反应，形容人老实无能、没出息。

examples.zh: 他一脚踢不出个屁来，别指望他出头。
examples.en: He's spineless, so don't expect him to speak up.

examples.zh: 一脚踢不出个屁来——窝囊废一个。
examples.en: What a hopeless wimp.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 一根藤上结的苦瓜——苦相连
pinyin: yī gēn téng shàng jié de kǔ guā —— kǔ xiāng lián
literal: one · vine · on · grow · 's · bitter melon — bitter · together · linked
natural: Bitter melons on one vine: linked in bitterness

meaning.en: People sharing the same hard lot.
meaning.zh: 同一根藤上的苦瓜，同苦相连，比喻命运相同、共患难。

examples.zh: 咱们是一根藤上结的苦瓜，苦相连，要互相帮助。
examples.en: We share the same hard lot, so we should help each other.

examples.zh: 一根藤上结的苦瓜——苦相连，他们同病相怜。
examples.en: They sympathise with each other.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 一根肠子通到底——直性子
pinyin: yī gēn cháng zi tōng dào dǐ —— zhí xìng zi
literal: one · intestine · through · to · bottom — straight · temperament
natural: One intestine straight through: a straight temper

meaning.en: Blunt and straightforward.
meaning.zh: 肠子直通到底，比喻性格直爽，不会拐弯。

equivalents: wear one's heart on one's sleeve

examples.zh: 她一根肠子通到底，有话就说。
examples.en: She's blunt and says what she thinks.

examples.zh: 一根肠子通到底——直性子，不会绕弯。
examples.en: A blunt person who doesn't beat about the bush.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 一杆没星的秤——不知轻重
pinyin: yī gǎn méi xīng de chèng —— bù zhī qīng zhòng
literal: one · (measure) · no · marks · 's · steelyard — not · know · light · heavy
natural: A steelyard without marks: no sense of weight

meaning.en: No sense of proportion or consequence.
meaning.zh: 没有刻度的秤称不出轻重，比喻说话做事不知分寸。

examples.zh: 他一杆没星的秤，说话不知轻重。
examples.en: He has no sense of proportion in what he says.

examples.zh: 一杆没星的秤——不知轻重，别让他处理这事。
examples.en: Don't let him handle this; he has no judgement.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 杨志卖刀——忍痛割爱
pinyin: yáng zhì mài dāo —— rěn tòng gē ài
literal: Yang Zhi · sell · sword — endure · pain · cut · love
natural: Yang Zhi selling his sword: parting with it painfully

meaning.en: Giving up something precious out of necessity.
meaning.zh: 杨志穷困潦倒被迫卖掉宝刀，比喻忍痛舍弃心爱之物。

examples.zh: 为了凑医药费，他杨志卖刀，忍痛卖了收藏。
examples.en: To cover medical bills he painfully sold his collection.

examples.zh: 杨志卖刀——忍痛割爱，这也是没办法。
examples.en: Parting with it hurts, but there was no choice.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. From 《水浒传》, where the penniless Yang Zhi sells his treasured sword.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。出自《水浒传》，杨志穷困卖刀。

text: 学理发碰上大胡子——难题（剃）
pinyin: xué lǐ fà pèng shàng dà hú zi —— nán tí (tì)
literal: learn · haircut · meet · big · beard — hard · problem (shave)
natural: A barber apprentice meets a big beard: a hard shave

meaning.en: A pun: 难题 (hard problem) sounds like 难剃 (hard to shave).
meaning.zh: 学理发遇上大胡子，难剃，谐“难题”，比喻遇到难题。

examples.zh: 新手学理发碰上大胡子，这下难题了。
examples.en: A trainee meeting a big beard; now there's a real challenge.

examples.zh: 学理发碰上大胡子——难题，怎么下手呢？
examples.en: A real puzzle; where to begin?

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. A pun: 题 (tí, problem) sounds like 剃 (tì, shave), so 难剃 hints at 难题, 'a hard problem'.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。谐音双关：“剃”与“题”音近，“难剃”暗指“难题”。

text: 秀才拿笤帚——斯文扫地
pinyin: xiù cái ná tiáo zhǒu —— sī wén sǎo dì
literal: scholar · hold · broom — refinement · sweep · floor
natural: A scholar holding a broom: culture swept away

meaning.en: Dignity or learning brought low.
meaning.zh: 秀才拿笤帚扫地，谐“斯文扫地”，比喻文人或文化的尊严受损。

examples.zh: 他当众出口成脏，秀才拿笤帚，斯文扫地。
examples.en: He swore in public and lost all dignity.

examples.zh: 秀才拿笤帚——斯文扫地，真丢人。
examples.en: What a disgrace.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. A pun on 斯文扫地 'refinement swept away'; 扫地 also means 'sweep the floor'.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。双关：“扫地”既指扫地面，也指颜面尽失。

text: 小卒子过河——有去无回
pinyin: xiǎo zú zi guò hé —— yǒu qù wú huí
literal: small · pawn · cross · river — have · go · no · return
natural: A pawn crossing the river: no way back

meaning.en: Once committed, there's no turning back.
meaning.zh: 象棋中卒过了河就不能后退，比喻只能前进、无法回头。

examples.zh: 事到如今，小卒子过河，有去无回。
examples.en: Now it's a case of no turning back.

examples.zh: 小卒子过河——有去无回，只能硬着头皮干。
examples.en: There's no going back, so we must press on.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. In Chinese chess a pawn that has crossed the river can only advance or move sideways.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。象棋中过河的卒只能前进或横走，不能后退。

text: 小娃娃扛大梁——自不量力
pinyin: xiǎo wá wá káng dà liáng —— zì bù liàng lì
literal: small · child · shoulder · big · beam — self · not · measure · strength
natural: A small child shouldering a great beam

meaning.en: Taking on more than one can handle.
meaning.zh: 小孩子扛大梁，比喻力量不够却硬撑。

equivalents: bite off more than one can chew

examples.zh: 他刚毕业就想挑大项目，小娃娃扛大梁，自不量力。
examples.en: Fresh out of university he wants a major project; out of his depth.

examples.zh: 小娃娃扛大梁，你可别逞强。
examples.en: Don't overreach.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 小偷进牧场——顺手牵羊
pinyin: xiǎo tōu jìn mù chǎng —— shùn shǒu qiān yáng
literal: thief · enter · pasture — convenient · hand · lead · sheep
natural: A thief entering a pasture: leading a sheep away as he goes

meaning.en: Taking something while one has the chance.
meaning.zh: 小偷进牧场就顺手牵走一只羊，比喻趁机拿走别人东西。

equivalents: pick up something on the way

examples.zh: 小偷进牧场，顺手牵羊，什么都往包里塞。
examples.en: He helps himself, stuffing everything into his bag.

examples.zh: 他逛超市总爱小偷进牧场似的顺手牵羊。
examples.en: He likes to pocket things at the supermarket.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 小偷击鼓进大堂——恶人先告状
pinyin: xiǎo tōu jī gǔ jìn dà táng —— è rén xiān gào zhuàng
literal: thief · beat · drum · enter · courtroom — bad · person · first · lodge · complaint
natural: A thief beating the drum to enter court

meaning.en: The guilty party complains first to shift blame.
meaning.zh: 小偷先去击鼓喊冤，比喻坏人先发制人、倒打一耙。

equivalents: the guilty party cries foul first

examples.zh: 明明是他错了，还小偷击鼓进大堂，恶人先告状。
examples.en: He's clearly in the wrong yet complains first.

examples.zh: 小偷击鼓进大堂——恶人先告状，别被他骗了。
examples.en: Don't be fooled by his accusations.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 小偷报警——贼喊捉贼
pinyin: xiǎo tōu bào jǐng —— zéi hǎn zhuō zéi
literal: thief · call · police — thief · shout · catch · thief
natural: A thief calling the police: crying 'stop thief'

meaning.en: Shifting blame by accusing others.
meaning.zh: 小偷报警，反咬别人是贼，比喻自己做坏事却装作抓坏人。

examples.zh: 他自己是主谋，还小偷报警，贼喊捉贼。
examples.en: He's the ringleader and still accuses others.

examples.zh: 小偷报警——贼喊捉贼，真是恶人先告状。
examples.en: The culprit blames others first.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 小拇指比大腿——差一大截
pinyin: xiǎo mǔ zhǐ bǐ dà tuǐ —— chà yī dà jié
literal: little · thumb · compare · thigh — differ · one · big · stretch
natural: Comparing a little finger with a thigh

meaning.en: Far inferior in comparison.
meaning.zh: 小指和大腿比，差得远，比喻两者相差悬殊。

examples.zh: 跟他比，我这点水平小拇指比大腿，差一大截。
examples.en: Compared with him, I'm nowhere near.

examples.zh: 小拇指比大腿——差一大截，不能比。
examples.en: They're not comparable.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。
